title: Pitch.
officialText:
Connectors shall rise vertically to the chimney or vent with a minimum pitch equal to one-fourth unit vertical in
12 units horizontal (2-percent slope).
previewText:
Connectors shall rise vertically to the chimney or vent with a minimum pitch equal to one-fourth unit vertical in
12 units horizontal (2-percent slope).
